Allah swears by the racing horses, breathing hard.
And by those that strike sparks with their hooves.
And by those that charge at dawn.
And rushing into the middle of the enemy.
Truly man is ungrateful to his Lord.
And he himself is a witness to it.
And he loves wealth very much.
Does he not know that when what is in the graves is thrown out.
And what is in the hearts is brought out.
On that Day their Lord will be fully aware of them.
